method: Read-only finite/all-channel checks, exact 80-bone name/parent/rest comparison, native source world-matrix and target FK endpoint comparisons. Endpoint alignment removes XZ origin only, never yaw or vertical differences. Closest phase is diagnostic, not a transition synthesis.
limits: No skin/foot-contact or interpolated transition acceptance
No start/stop phase scheduling is installed in bccc runtime
Source author files share a skeleton but exact splice continuity is measured separately
Existing UPF scales every clip with one shared Idle source/target reference-Hips-height ratio; no root motion is discarded
No model/IBM, runtime or bone-angle edits
